newsitem.title: USA: EPA reduces proposed fine against Lafarge.
newsitem.headline: EPA reduces proposed fine against Lafarge.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said it has amended a complaint to cut a proposed fine against Lafarge Corp to $105,425 from $436,815 in a case involving alleged waste burning at two Lafarge cement kilns.

The EPA dropped three allegations from the complaint after the company showed it had been granted an exemption from hazardous waste limits for testing purposes on days the majority of violations allegedly took place, the agency said in a statement issued Friday.
Lafarge still faces allegations of violations for exceeding waste limits on days when no testing took place, the EPA said.
The agency amended the complaint on May 21.
